# ITECX — First Fibonacci International Congress on Engineering, Technology, and Mathematics

> ITECX (itecx.kz) is an international science congress and research project
> competition held in Kazakhstan for school students (grades 3–11, track
> "ITECX college") and for university students, lecturers and professors
> (track "ITECX academic"). Fields: educational technology, science,
> mathematics, engineering. Stages: school stage → national congress in
> Kazakhstan → international final in Italy. Participants prepare a four-part
> research paper, a 10-minute talk and a poster (5-minute defense); the
> national stage is held in the native language, the final in English. The
> best works of the final are considered for publication in the indexed
> Fibonacci scientific journal. Organizer: AZ GROUP LLC, Astana, Kazakhstan.
